messages.content: Good morning. This is Priya from Maxis enterprise testing — tenant id `tnt-myx-enterprise-007`. We're rolling out a new SD-WAN site at our Penang factory next week and I need to book a TaaS slot to validate WAN throughput and latency between Penang and our Cyberjaya datacenter before go-live. Can you check available slots for tomorrow night, say 11 PM to 3 AM Malaysia time? End-to-end scope, throughput and latency probe capabilities.

Good morning, Madam Priya. I will search TaaS slots for tenant `tnt-myx-enterprise-007` between 22 May 23:00 and 23 May 03:00 Malaysia time, scoped end_to_end, with throughput and latency_probe capabilities. Please hold on for a moment.

The earlier slot **`slot-2026-0523-PG-CYB-A1`** scores higher (0.93) and includes path_trace + packet_loss which would be valuable for SD-WAN validation. Would you like me to create a test plan and reserve that slot for you?

Yes, go with slot A1. Boleh tolong create test plan dulu — name dia `penang-sdwan-golive-validation`. Target adalah path antara Penang factory ke Cyberjaya DC. Saya nak include throughput minimum 800 Mbps, latency max 20 ms, packet loss kurang dari 0.1 percent, dan jitter max 5 ms. Protocol TCP untuk throughput, ICMP untuk latency. Bidirectional.

Certainly, Madam. I will create the test plan `penang-sdwan-golive-validation` with bidirectional throughput (TCP), latency (ICMP), packet loss and jitter SLOs as you specified. Please hold on for a moment.
